name: Kung pao chicken
description: Diced chicken with peanuts and dried chillies in a sweet-sour-numbing sauce.

tcm.note: Dried chilli and Sichuan pepper over chicken — hot and dispersing.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna in a high degree.

histamine.note: Soy sauce and rice vinegar are both fermented; peanuts and chilli are both liberators.

nutrition.highlight: sweet, sour and numbing at once
